udt_struct_v0.doc:
The whole on-chain record of a hold \xe2\x80\x94 three fields, each required:
* `owner`  \xe2\x80\x94 the funds are returned to it on release/cancel, and its `Locked` total is
decremented; without it the contract cannot move the custody back.
* `amount` \xe2\x80\x94 exactly what to transfer back or onward; without it a finalize cannot move value.
* `status` \xe2\x80\x94 the state machine (see [`HoldStatus`]).
The id is the storage key, not a field. There is no other field.
udt_struct_v0.name: Hold

udt_error_enum_v0.doc: Numeric codes 1..=6 are identical to v1/v2 so the backend's error mapping is unchanged. `NotInitialized` and\n`AlreadyInitialized` are unreachable in v3 (an instance cannot exist unconfigured and there is no `initialize`); they keep\ntheir numbers so no code is ever reused with a different meaning.
udt_error_enum_v0.name: HoldError

cases.doc: v3: the constructor's `token` is not a Stellar Asset Contract.
cases.name: InvalidToken

udt_enum_v0.doc: The hold state machine. Encoded on-chain as a bare `u32` (0..=3) rather than a named variant,\nso the stored value carries no readable words. Required: the state machine is what makes\ndouble-finalization impossible.
udt_enum_v0.name: HoldStatus

event_v0.doc:
The contract's own events carry ONLY the opaque id: the owner and amount are already public in
the SAC `transfer` event emitted in the same transaction, so repeating them here would add
nothing but a second place to find them. Topic names are lower-case so a v2 event can never be
mistaken for a v1 `HOLD_*` event by an indexer.
event_v0.name: HoldCreatedEvent

event_v0.doc: Emitted by `set_controller`. Addresses only: a governance fact, kept so a controller change is\nauditable from the chain itself.
event_v0.name: ControllerChangedEvent

function_v0.doc: Read-only. `None` for an unknown id \xe2\x80\x94 a missing hold is a legitimate observed state.
function_v0.name: get_hold

function_v0.doc: Read-only: the configured Hold Controller. Always `Some` in v3; kept as `Option` so the v2 read interface is unchanged.
function_v0.name: get_admin

function_v0.doc: Read-only: the configured SAC token contract. Always `Some` in v3; kept as `Option` like `get_admin`.
function_v0.name: get_token

function_v0.doc: Cancels an ACTIVE hold \xe2\x80\x94 the funds return to the original owner, with a distinct terminal\nstatus from `release_hold` (same custody mechanics, different audit meaning).
function_v0.name: cancel_hold

function_v0.doc:
Locks `amount` of TRS belonging to `owner` under a new hold identified by the opaque
`hold_id` (32 random bytes chosen by the backend).

Authorization: BOTH the Hold Controller AND `owner` must authorize this call.
Real custody: on success the owner's SAC balance decreases by `amount` and this contract's
SAC balance increases by the same amount.
function_v0.name: create_hold

function_v0.doc:
Settles an ACTIVE hold \xe2\x80\x94 the funds move to `destination`, never to the owner
automatically. The destination is supplied by the authorized controller for this call
only; it is a transfer target, not stored contract state. Every settlement goes through this
one function \xe2\x80\x94 nothing on-chain marks one settlement as different from another.
function_v0.name: settle_hold

function_v0.doc: Releases an ACTIVE hold \xe2\x80\x94 the funds return to the original owner.
function_v0.name: release_hold

function_v0.doc:
Configures the Hold Controller (`admin`) and the SAC token contract. Run by the Soroban host exactly once, inside the
host function that creates this instance, so there is no window in which the instance exists unconfigured (F11), and
the host rejects any later invocation of `__constructor`. Creating an instance without these arguments fails.

Authorization: `admin` must authorize (it is normally the deploying transaction's source account).
`token` must be a Stellar Asset Contract \xe2\x80\x94 anything else aborts the creation with `InvalidToken`.
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc: Controller rotation: requires the CURRENT controller's AND `new_controller`'s authorization (v3, F21 \xe2\x80\x94 the new key\nproves it exists and is held before it becomes the only key able to finalize holds) and emits `controller_changed`.
function_v0.name: set_controller

function_v0.doc: Read-only, O(1): the sum of every currently-ACTIVE hold amount for `owner`.
function_v0.name: get_locked_amount
